transitions.historical_text: After activation, this card is treated as an Equip Card that increases the ATK of the equipped monster by 500 points. Equip a monster on your side of the field with this card. If this card is destroyed by the effect of another card while it is an Equip Card, select 1 card on the field and destroy it.
transitions.summary: Era damage-step legality, not a text erratum: the GOAT script carries EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL on the activation, so this Trap can be activated inside the damage-calculation substep; the modern script carries only EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP, so the engine refuses activation there. The guard functions are equivalent - goat's s.condition ('Duel.GetCurrentPhase()~=PHASE_DAMAGE or not Duel.IsDamageCalculated()') is the same predicate as the modern aux.StatChangeDamageStepCondition (utility.lua:1412) - so the property flag is the whole difference. No dated source for when the TCG window changed was found; chronology unresolved.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the current text (BP03-EN194, Battle Pack 3: Monster League)

transitions.historical_text: After activation, this card is treated as an Equip Card that increases the ATK of the equipped monster by 500 points. Equip a monster on your side of the field with this card. If this card is destroyed by the effect of another card while it is an Equip Card, select 1 card on the field and destroy it.
transitions.modern_text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.
transitions.summary: Wording modernisation only (v3 BP01-EN093 is the PSCT rewrite to 'Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK...', v4 BP03-EN194 changes 'When' to 'If' on the destruction trigger). Both scripts already carry EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET, so the explicit 'Target' wording is not a targeting change, and the destruction trigger's condition (destroyed by a card effect while equipped) is unchanged in the diff.

review.notes: Everything else in the diff is verified inert: 'r&0x41==0x41' is exactly REASON_DESTROY|REASON_EFFECT; 'RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD' equals 'RESET_EVENT|RESETS_STANDARD' for disjoint bit constants; Duel.SelectTarget(tp,nil,...) and (tp,aux.TRUE,...) select the same cards; the extra 'tc and' is a nil guard. The goat cdb text matches v2 (DB2-EN197, 2005-07-27) exactly. Trailing cosmetic after the modern text index: v5 (SBC2-ENC21, 2024-12-13) drops the article in 'by card effect'. Same rule-profile check as Aqua Chorus: the damage-calculation window is a per-effect property flag, not a GOAT duel-flag behaviour, so the substitution is not redundant.
